# Which of your Amazon SKUs actually make money?

> Free Amazon seller profit analyzer: drop in your Seller Central Transaction report CSV and get profit per SKU, a fee waterfall, ad spend, refund and reimbursement findings. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
